body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2008') -- <Visual News> IOTEK(www.ezsecu.com) presented its 2.5-inch HDD case 'ezSECU' duing CES 2008, which is dubbed as 'Data Locker' in North America. Adopting a touch panel for code input, the ezSECU supports one-touch locking function. It runs on Windows 2000, XP, Vista as well as iMac OS 9.2.
